t: This is the London home of Prostate Cancer UK, a charity that carries out research, raises awareness and offers support around prostate cancer. It's registered in England and Wales, and in Scotland. It was founded by Jonathan Waxman, a British oncologist and emeritus professor of oncology at Imperial College London. He's a clinician who has helped develop cancer treatments that are now part of standard practice, and he's also the author of four novels, including The Elephant in the Room.
